source_snapshot.procedure: Connect UART dongle per function team; check 115200 bps.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH with pinout/voltage, framing, harmless TX and sanitized capture.

old_problem: Baud alone is insufficient: header/pinout, logic voltage/isolation, adapter, power-state connection, framing/flow control, expected output and harmless input are absent. Wrong wiring can damage the BMC and console data can expose secrets.
disposition_reason: The physical operation is manual under ED-09, but the missing electrical level and pinout are core hardware compatibility evidence explicitly requiring a blocking status. They cannot be treated as ordinary IDs or inferred from generic UART standards. Keyboard-control coverage also needs one safe production-policy-approved interaction.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2267 and 2268, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve physical UART dongle, 115200 receive readability and keyboard/TX control coverage; SSH cannot substitute.
Require board/header designator, RX/TX/GND only, voltage/isolation, adapter and safe connection/disconnection power state from the hardware owner.
Require complete baud/data/parity/stop/flow settings, expected banner/content and one harmless command/keystroke-response oracle.
A qualified operator handles hardware and sanitizes credential/token output; never drive board power or send break/bootloader/destructive input.
No chassis/header contact, UART connection, serial capture, keyboard input or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Board-approved BMC debug UART electrical RX/TX validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the exact physical BMC debug UART at 115200 produces intelligible sanitized console data and accepts one bounded harmless keyboard interaction through an electrically compatible adapter.
required_package: Board revision, UART header/designator and RX/TX/GND pinout
Logic level/isolation, approved adapter and safe connection power state
Approved harmless TX interaction/response plus console access/redaction policy
test_case.test_command: Gate closed. A qualified operator follows the board ESD/power procedure, connects only approved RX/TX/GND at the documented voltage, captures timestamped serial output with full framing, sends exactly one approved harmless input, captures its response, then disconnects and verifies platform health.
test_case.expected_result: The electrically correct UART produces stable human-readable expected console content at the complete 115200 framing, the single safe input yields its exact expected non-destructive response, no secrets remain unredacted and the platform stays healthy after disconnect.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative electrical/pinout/framing and RX plus TX evidence. Missing compatibility keeps Pending and execution BLOCKED. Garbled output, contention, wrong response, secret exposure or instability is FAIL.
safety_gate: No connection until board pinout/voltage/isolation is signed.
Qualified operator and ESD-safe authorized power state.
Never connect adapter power or guess pins; no break/bootloader/destructive input.
Stop on heat, contention, corruption, unexpected privilege or instability.
expected_evidence: Approved TX input and exact response
test_case.recovery: On contention, garbling or instability, stop TX, safely disconnect per board procedure, preserve sanitized capture and let the hardware/BMC owner inspect; do not reconnect with guessed wiring.

source_conflict.reason: Source coherently requires physical UART RX/TX; it omits compatibility evidence.

blocked.reason: Wrong voltage/pinout can damage hardware, so execution is blocked until authoritative compatibility and safe TX exist.
